<h3>24 February 2026 - Unscheduled Council Meeting</h3>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Notice of Unscheduled Council Meeting on Tuesday 24 February 2026, 6pm at the Civic Centre, Council Offices, 25 Ferres Boulevard, South Morang to further consider an undisclosed item of business from the Council meeting held on 17 February 2026.</p>
<p>The further consideration of the undisclosed item has been designated as confidential in accordance with sections 66(5) and 3(1) of the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em> on the grounds that it contains personal information, being information which if released would result in the unreasonable disclosure of information about any person or their personal affairs.  </p>

<h3>24 April 2025 - Unscheduled Council Meeting</h3>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p><strong>Notice of Unscheduled Council Meeting</strong></p>
<p>Thursday 24 April, 6pm<br />
<span style="font-size: 1em;">Civic Centre, Council Offices, 25 Ferres Boulevard, South Morang</span></p>
<p>An Unscheduled Council Meeting has been called to consider the following items of business:</p>
<ol>
<li>Election of a Mayor to serve the remaining period of the previous Mayor’s term, and in the event the current Deputy Mayor is elected Mayor, the election of a Deputy Mayor for the remaining period of the Deputy Mayor’s term.</li>
<li>Tabling of the Governor in Council Order.</li>
<li>Tabling of the Election Report for Whittlesea City Council 2024 Local Government Elections.</li>
</ol>
<p>The election of a Mayor cannot be safely or conveniently considered at the next Scheduled Council Meeting as a Mayor, in accordance with section 26 (6) of the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, must be elected within one month after any vacancy in the office of Mayor occurs.</p>
<p>Additionally, a Governor in Council Order given to the Council in accordance with section 229A (4) of the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em> must be tabled and recorded in the minutes of the next Council meeting.</p>
<p>The <em>Local Government (Electoral) Regulations 2020</em> require a copy of the Election Report for Whittlesea City Council 2024 Local Government Elections must be submitted to the Council at the earliest practicable meeting after the CEO received the report.</p>
<p>Please note that public questions and submissions are not permitted at Unscheduled Council Meetings in accordance with Council’s Governance Rules.</p>

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p><strong>Notice of Unscheduled Council Meeting</strong></p>
<p>Tuesday 25 February, 6pm</p>
<p>Civic Centre, Council Offices, 25 Ferres Boulevard, South Morang</p>
<p>In accordance with Clause 10 of the Governance Rules, we request an urgent Unscheduled Council Meeting to be held in person at 6pm on Tuesday 25 February 2025 in the Council Chamber, City of Whittlesea, 25 Ferres Boulevard, South Morang.</p>
<p>The business to be transacted at this meeting is the consideration of the following matters:</p>
<ul>
<li>Draft Election Period Policy</li>
<li>Councillor Social Media Policy</li>
<li>Councillor Communication Policy</li>
</ul>
<p>The consideration of these items cannot be safely or conveniently considered at the next Scheduled Council Meeting due to the upcoming Federal election which may be announced prior to the March Council meeting. Items 2 and 3 are referenced within the Election Period Policy therefore need to be adopted.</p>
<p>Please note that public questions and submissions are not permitted at Unscheduled Council Meetings in accordance with Council’s Governance Rules.</p>

<h3>4 February 2025 - Unscheduled Council Meeting</h3>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>An Unscheduled Council Meeting has been called to consider one item of business:</p>
<ul>
<li>Potential breaches of the Model Councillor Code of Conduct by the Mayor, Cr McLindon</li>

<p>The matter has been designated confidential in accordance with sections 66(5) and 3 (1)(i) of the Local Government Act 2020, therefore the meeting will move into camera once formally opened.</p>

        (function () {

            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);
